title: Validity and Minimum Application of Snowsports School Credit, Product by Product
content:
School credit issued on a Snowsports School booking carries two published figures: the number of calendar days from issue within which it must be spent, and the smallest amount in USD that may be applied to a single charge.

| Product | Credit validity (calendar days) | Smallest application (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 180 | 25.00 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 180 | 25.00 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 180 | 25.00 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 365 | 50.00 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 270 | 50.00 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 270 | 50.00 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 365 | 100.00 |

## Notes on the two figures

The three single-date group products carry the shortest validity, 180 calendar days, and the lowest smallest application, 25.00 USD. The Semi-Private Coaching Session and the Private Instruction Full Day carry 270 calendar days and 50.00 USD. The Six-Week Development Programme carries 365 calendar days with a smallest application of 50.00 USD, and the Elite Performance Camp carries 365 calendar days with the highest smallest application in the range, 100.00 USD.

Credit standing at 24.00 USD against a charge on an All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson booking is below that product's smallest application of 25.00 USD; credit standing at exactly 25.00 USD is at it.
